description: Get one send by id: its status, what the receiving server said, the Message-ID it went out with, and, for a campaign that tracks them, when a person first opened it or clicked a link and how many times. Only what a person did counts: never a mail scanner or an image proxy, never an open within 60 seconds or a click within 30 seconds of the email leaving (a filter looking at it, not a person reading it), and never two links from one network within 5 seconds of each other. An open is the email's image loading, so a person who reads with images off never counts: an open count is a floor, not a read rate. For warmup emails, the other mailbox's details are private. `to`, `toName`, `subject`, `messageId`, `providerMessageId` and `errorDetail` are null. `cc` and `bcc` are empty lists. You can still read your mailbox, the send's status and failure code, its counts and dates. A send in another workspace answers 404. `deliveredAt` and `deferredAt` keep the first recorded delivery and delay notices after the event feed expires. Delivery means the recipient's server accepted the email, not that it reached an inbox. Null means no notice was recorded. To show one outcome, read `complainedAt`, then `bouncedAt`, then `deliveredAt`, then `deferredAt`. A later delay never takes back a delivery.
name: get_send
title: Get a send
